title: Technical Product Manager (TPM) Role Instructions
instructionLines: The candidate is applying for the role of: Technical Product Manager (TPM).

sections.heading: Core Evaluation Areas Across Levels
lines: 1. Technical Depth & Architecture Fluency: Deep understanding of system dependencies, APIs, data flows, and infrastructure constraints.
2. Program Management & Execution: Driving cross-team technical deliverables, dependency mapping, critical path management, and risk mitigation.
3. Stakeholder Communication: Translating complex technical constraints to business leaders and product strategy to engineering teams.
4. Operational Governance: Tracking release telemetry, launch readiness checklists, and incident management.
